notes:
PlaneSite 2.0.6:
- Export boundaries for Ceres Applicator View: obstacles now come in as obstacles. The field and each obstacle are written as separate shapes tagged the way Applicator View recognises, instead of holes in the field (which it set to Skip).
- Also in 2.0.5: XAG export writes just the KML (GeoJSON is an option). In 2.0.4: seams keep power lines and fences in one piece.
